name: Randek ZeroLabor robotic insulation cell
summary: Robot cell in which two industrial robots move a blow-in plate over each cavity of a closed timber or steel-frame wall element and fill it with wood fibre, glass wool or cellulose to the design density, logging the material used per element. Part of Randek's ZeroLabor family of prefab robot cells.

germany.statusNote: Sold on request by Randek (Sweden) after a pre-study; Randek names Horn Hausbau Technologie as its representative for Germany, Austria and Switzerland. No price published.
germany.leadTime: Set per project in a pre-study (maker)

sellers.name: Horn Hausbau Technologie (Wolfgang Horn)
sellers.note: Randek's representative for Germany, Austria and Switzerland; no address or phone on the page.

specs.label: Robots
specs.quote: Two robots fill closed elements with blown-in insulation, to the volume and density the design data sets.

specs.label: Blow-in plate
specs.value: one per robot, five nozzles each fed from its own supply
specs.quote: Blow-in platesOne per robot, with five nozzles, each fed from its own supply.

specs.label: Insulation materials
specs.value: wood fibre, glass wool or cellulose
specs.conditions: via the ISOFLOC easyfloc blow-in system
specs.quote: Insulation materialsWood fibre, glass wool or cellulose, through the ISOFLOC easyfloc blow-in system.

specs.label: Material bunker
specs.quote: Material handlingA bunker system of about 20 m³ feeds the cell.

specs.label: Heaviest element
specs.conditions: about; cell table sets its width to each element
specs.quote: Cell tableSets its width to each element automatically, for elements up to about 3,000 kg.

specs.label: Quality record
specs.quote: Traceable qualityA weighing protocol logs the material used in every element.

notes: Blows loose-fill insulation into closed cavities rather than inserting batts; it does the same job of insulating the frame bays.
Cavities too small to fill are flagged for manual finishing downstream (maker).
Fills timber and light-gauge-steel elements alike.
